# Skill Forger E2E

> Ship an agent skill end to end: scaffold, lint, a 0-100 readiness score and GitHub Action, retrofit for existing repos, a live install test from GitHub, header image and trust badges, security workflows, ship gates (Verified, owner-only authorship, sole contributor) and launch done end to end by the agent. Writing and evals hand off to skill-creator.

## Install

- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add maumoya/skill-forger-e2e` then `/plugin install skill-forger-e2e@skill-forger-e2e`
- Any agent: `npx skills add maumoya/skill-forger-e2e`

## Files

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/maumoya/skill-forger-e2e/blob/main/skills/skill-forger-e2e/SKILL.md): the eight phases and their gates
- [authoring.md](https://github.com/maumoya/skill-forger-e2e/blob/main/skills/skill-forger-e2e/references/authoring.md): frontmatter and body rules
- [testing.md](https://github.com/maumoya/skill-forger-e2e/blob/main/skills/skill-forger-e2e/references/testing.md): lint, trigger tests, claude plugin eval
- [packaging.md](https://github.com/maumoya/skill-forger-e2e/blob/main/skills/skill-forger-e2e/references/packaging.md): plugin layout, install paths, live install test, readiness score in CI
- [action.yml](https://github.com/maumoya/skill-forger-e2e/blob/main/action.yml): GitHub Action that lints and scores any skill repo and enforces the ship gates (`uses: maumoya/skill-forger-e2e@v0.15.0`)
- [repo_guard.sh](https://github.com/maumoya/skill-forger-e2e/blob/main/skills/skill-forger-e2e/scripts/repo_guard.sh): checks branch ruleset, private reporting, description, topics, release and Marketplace listing on every change; --apply fixes the first two
- [make_demo.sh](https://github.com/maumoya/skill-forger-e2e/blob/main/skills/skill-forger-e2e/scripts/make_demo.sh): README demo video card (<=10 s GIF) from a recording or a URL
- [make_header.sh](https://github.com/maumoya/skill-forger-e2e/blob/main/skills/skill-forger-e2e/scripts/make_header.sh): 1280x640 README header and social preview
- [security.md](https://github.com/maumoya/skill-forger-e2e/blob/main/skills/skill-forger-e2e/references/security.md): Scorecard, CodeQL, pinning, SLSA
- [launch.md](https://github.com/maumoya/skill-forger-e2e/blob/main/skills/skill-forger-e2e/references/launch.md): README, discovery, channels
- [README.md](https://github.com/maumoya/skill-forger-e2e/blob/main/README.md)
